keyword.en: diesel 30 concrete pump aggregate size which line
keyword.zh: 柴油30骨料粒径以哪一行为准

title.en: How Diesel 30 Prints Two Aggregate Wordings
title.zh: 柴油30为什么出现两种骨料说法

description.en: Diesel 30's specification row says 3 cm and below. The introductory line also says 1 cm aggregate. The page does not say which phrase overrides the other.
description.zh: 柴油30的规格行写 3 cm 及以下。介绍句里又写了 1 cm 骨料。页面没有说哪一句覆盖另一句。

h1.en: How Diesel 30 Prints Two Aggregate Wordings
h1.zh: 柴油30为什么出现两种骨料说法

directAnswer.en: Read both published wordings on the Diesel 30 concrete pump from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. The specification table prints maximum aggregate size as 3 cm and below. The introductory line prints 60 m / 180 m and, in parentheses, 1 cm aggregate. Diesel 40 and Diesel 50 introductions also say 1 cm aggregate, while their specification tables print no aggregate row at all. This note does not choose a winner. Confirm the mix through /en/contact/.
directAnswer.zh: 柴油30混凝土泵来自河北品锦机械在邢台的页面，两种已公布说法都要读。规格表的最大骨料粒径是 3 cm 及以下。介绍句印了 60 m / 180 m，括号里又写 1 cm 骨料。柴油40和柴油50的介绍也写了 1 cm 骨料，但它们的规格表根本没有骨料行。本文不替你选定一句。配合比请通过 /zh/contact/ 确认。

body.en: Diesel 30's table includes maximum aggregate size 3 cm and below, with engine 4105 / 56 kW, 15 m³/h, 20 MPa and distance 60 m / 180 m. That table is the structured cell list. It does not contain a second aggregate row labelled 1 cm.
body.zh: 柴油30的表包含最大骨料粒径 3 cm 及以下，以及发动机 4105 / 56 kW、15 m³/h、20 MPa、距离 60 m / 180 m。这是成行的格子。表里没有另一行标成 1 cm 的骨料。

body.en: The short introduction on Diesel 30, Diesel 40 and Diesel 50 includes the parenthesis 1 cm aggregate. On Diesel 40 and Diesel 50 there is no aggregate line in the specification table to compare. Hebei Pinjin Machinery has published both texts. It has not published a sentence that says the parenthesis replaces the table, or the reverse.
body.zh: 柴油30、柴油40和柴油50的简短介绍都带括号“1 cm aggregate”。柴油40和柴油50的规格表里没有骨料行可以对照。河北品锦机械把两种文字都公布了。它没有公布一句说括号代替表格，或表格代替括号。

body.en: Do not average 1 cm and 3 cm. Do not copy Electric 20's 1–2 cm into Diesel 30 to break the tie. Send the model and the mix to the contact page. Until the factory confirms, quote the conflict instead of hiding one of the lines.
body.zh: 不要把 1 cm 和 3 cm 取平均。不要把电动20的 1–2 cm 抄进柴油30来打破僵局。把型号和配合比发到联系页。工厂确认之前，应写出这个不一致，而不是藏起其中一行。

question.en: What does the Diesel 30 table say?

answer.en: Maximum aggregate size is 3 cm and below.
answer.zh: 最大骨料粒径为 3 cm 及以下。

answer.en: In the introductory line of Diesel 30, and also in the introductions of Diesel 40 and Diesel 50.
answer.zh: 在柴油30的介绍句里，柴油40和柴油50的介绍句里也有。

question.en: Do Diesel 40 and Diesel 50 have a table row for aggregate?
question.zh: 柴油40和柴油50的表格有骨料行吗？

answer.en: No. Their specification tables omit that row.
answer.zh: 没有。它们的规格表省略了这一行。

question.en: Should the website pick 1 cm or 3 cm?
question.zh: 网站应该选定 1 cm 还是 3 cm？

answer.en: No. Hebei Pinjin Machinery has not printed a rule that discards either wording. Ask the factory.
answer.zh: 不应该。河北品锦机械没有印出一条规则来废弃其中一种说法。请问工厂。
